app.name: Budget Flow
app.description: BudgetFlow is a personal budgeting app that does the heavy lifting for you. Set up your income, bills, and subscriptions once — and BudgetFlow automatically tracks your financial picture every month. Watch your savings grow, spot spending trends, and see your full financial history at a glance.

features.title: Budget Once, Track Forever
features.description: Set up your income and expenses once — BudgetFlow handles the rest automatically every month.

features.title: Full Financial History
features.description: See your complete financial timeline month by month, going back as far as you've used the app.

features.title: Smart Expense Management
features.description: Add bills, subscriptions, and groceries. Quarterly and annual expenses are automatically smoothed into monthly amounts.

features.title: Paycheck Calculator
features.description: Supports salary and hourly income, all pay frequencies and paycheck deductions.

features.title: Savings Planner
features.description: Set a savings percentage and optional minimum floor. BudgetFlow tells you exactly how much to save each month.

features.title: Insights & Trends
features.description: Spot spending patterns, compare months side by side, and track your best saving streaks over time.

features.title: Overspending Alerts
features.description: Get instant warnings when expenses exceed income so you're never caught off guard.

features.title: Private By Design
features.description: Everything stays on your device. No account, no cloud sync, no ads, no data collection.

downloads.description: Works on all supported Android devices.
